posts.author: Z-Rune
posts.body:
Short and sweet: the crafting plugin crashes when the option is selected in the menu.
I'm very ignorant to programming language so this is all gibberish to me.
My note tags are a copy/paste of the example given in the help file, both trying the ID as well as the name. I even tried just gold to see if it was the items I was using as ingredients. Any help would be deeply appreciated.
Quick update:
I disabled masking and it seemed to have fixed the issue. This is a little inconvenient as I would like the masking to be used for my project so I'm still very open to any proposed solutions.

posts.body:
This is interesting.
Only the programmer who wrote the code can truly understand it.
Even if someone can read code, it doesn’t mean they can fully grasp what others have written.
This naturally leads to the mindset that if I have the ability to write my own code, I will do so.
If I can avoid using others' code, I will.
